name: Blade
description:
A member of the Stellaron Hunters, and a swordsman who abandoned his body to become a blade.
Pledges loyalty to "Destiny's Slave," and possesses a terrifying self-healing ability.

skills.name: Shard Sword
skills.desc: Deals #1[i]% of Blade's ATK as Wind DMG to a target enemy.
skills.simpleDesc: Deals minor Wind DMG to an enemy.

skills.name: Hellscape
skills.desc:
Consumes HP equal to #1[i]% of Blade's Max HP to enter the Hellscape state.
When Hellscape is active, his Skill cannot be used, his DMG dealt increases by #4[i]%, and his Basic ATK Shard Sword is enhanced to Forest of Swords for #2[i] turn(s).
If Blade's current HP is insufficient, his HP will be reduced to 1 when he uses his Skill.
This Skill does not regenerate Energy. Using this Skill does not end the current turn.
skills.simpleDesc: Consumes HP to Enhance Basic ATK, and this turn does not end after this Skill is used.

skills.name: Death Sentence
skills.desc:
Sets Blade's current HP to 50% of his Max HP and deals Wind DMG to one enemy equal to the sum of #1[i]% of his ATK, #2[i]% of his Max HP, and #5[i]% of the tally of Blade's HP loss in the current battle. At the same time, deals Wind DMG to adjacent targets equal to the sum of #3[f1]% of his ATK, #4[i]% of his Max HP, and #6[i]% of the tally of his HP loss in the current battle.
The tally of Blade's HP loss in the current battle is capped at #7[i]% of his Max HP. This value will be reset and re-accumulated after his Ultimate has been used.
skills.simpleDesc: Sets current HP to 50% of Max HP, and deals massive Wind DMG to one enemy and Wind DMG to adjacent targets.

skills.name: Shuhu's Gift
skills.desc:
When Blade sustains DMG or consumes his HP, he gains 1 stack of Charge, stacking up to 5 times. A max of 1 Charge stack can be gained every time he is attacked.
When Charge stack reaches maximum, immediately launches a Follow-Up ATK on all enemies, dealing Wind DMG equal to #2[i]% of Blade's ATK plus #4[i]% of his Max HP. At the same time, restores Blade's HP by #3[i]% of his Max HP. After the Follow-Up ATK, all Charges are consumed.
skills.simpleDesc: When Blade's HP decreases, gains 1 stack of Charge. Upon reaching maximum Charge, launches Follow-Up ATK, dealing Wind DMG to all enemies, restoring HP, and consuming all Charges.

extra.name: Follow-Up ATK
extra.desc: Unleashes an extra attack on the target. This effect is triggered automatically when requirements are met.

skills.name: Karma Wind
skills.desc:
Immediately attacks the enemy. After entering combat, consumes #2[i]% of Blade's Max HP while dealing Wind DMG equal to #1[i]% of his Max HP to all enemies.
If Blade's current HP is insufficient, his HP will be reduced to 1 when this Technique is used.
skills.simpleDesc: Attacks the enemy. After entering combat, consumes own HP and deals Wind DMG to all enemies.

eidolons.name: Blade Cuts the Deepest in Hell
eidolons.desc:
Blade's Ultimate deals additionally increased DMG to one designated enemy target, with the increased amount equal to 150% of the tally of Blade's HP loss in the current battle.
The tally of Blade's HP loss in the current battle is capped at 90% of his Max HP. The tally value will be reset and re-accumulated after his Ultimate has been used.

eidolons.name: Ten Thousand Sorrows From One Broken Dream
eidolons.desc: When Blade is in the <link kind="skill" to="hellscape">Hellscape</link> state, his CRIT Rate increases by 15%.

eidolons.name: Hardened Blade Bleeds Coldest Shade
eidolons.desc:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: Rejected by Death, Infected With Life
eidolons.desc: When Blade's current HP percentage drops to 50% or lower of his Max HP, increases his Max HP by 20%. Stacks up to 2 time(s).

eidolons.name: Death By Ten Lords' Gaze
eidolons.desc:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: Reborn Into an Empty Husk
eidolons.desc: The maximum number of Charge stacks is reduced to 4. The <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> triggered by Talent deals additionally increased DMG, with the increased amount equal to 50% of Blade's Max HP.

extra.name: Follow-Up ATK
extra.desc: Unleashes an extra attack on the target. This effect is triggered automatically when requirements are met.

embedBonusSkill.name: Vita Infinita
embedBonusSkill.desc: When Blade's current HP percentage is at 50% of Max HP or lower, the HP restored when receiving healing increases by 20%.

embedBonusSkill.name: Neverending Deaths
embedBonusSkill.desc: If Blade hits a <u>Weakness Broken</u> enemy after using "Forest of Swords," he will restore HP equal to 5% of his Max HP plus 100.

embedBonusSkill.name: Cyclone of Destruction
embedBonusSkill.desc: Increases DMG dealt by the Talent's <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> by 20%.

embedBonusSkill.name: Vita Infinita
embedBonusSkill.desc: When Blade uses Ultimate, the amount cleared from the tally of HP loss is changed to 50%.

embedBonusSkill.name: Neverending Deaths
embedBonusSkill.desc: HP restored from healing increases by 20%. After receiving healing, converts 25% of the healed amount to Ultimate's tally of HP loss.

embedBonusSkill.name: Cyclone of Destruction
embedBonusSkill.desc: Increases <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> DMG from Talent by 20% and additionally regenerates 15 Energy.
